name: Battleground
overview:
Battleground brings a unique concept on your screens in the form of fitness reality show. We bring together the nation's most dedicated fitness enthusiasts for the fitness battle. This show blends action, fitness, determination and drama. Get ready to watch the contestants push themselves to their physical and mental limits as they battle it out in the show. The contestants fight to become India's next Fitness & Action Star,

16 contestants compete for India's fitness superstar title in a 28-day challenge. Teams face physical trials and get mentorship from fitness icons. One male and female winner emerge through tests of strength and endurance.
